title: Aṣṭādhyāyī Game Question Bank
scope_note: A finite, reviewed starter bank for the supplied topic set. Literal 'all possible' questions cannot be enumerated because forms and examples can be varied indefinitely; use the included tables and question types to generate more rounds.
content_note: Core game questions follow the attached study topics. The samāsa set is marked as a bonus extension. Advanced derivations should be reviewed against the learner's preferred पाठ before publishing.

questions.prompt: Which set is the क-वर्ग?
questions.explanation: The five vargas are grouped by their place of articulation.

questions.prompt: What is the place of articulation of the क-वर्ग?
questions.explanation: The क-वर्ग is guttural (कण्ठ्य).

questions.prompt: What is the place of articulation of the च-वर्ग?
questions.explanation: The च-वर्ग is palatal (तालव्य).

questions.prompt: What is the place of articulation of the ट-वर्ग?
questions.explanation: The ट-वर्ग is retroflex/cerebral (मूर्धन्य).

questions.prompt: What is the place of articulation of the त-वर्ग?
questions.explanation: The त-वर्ग is dental (दन्त्य).

questions.prompt: What is the place of articulation of the प-वर्ग?
questions.explanation: The प-वर्ग is labial (ओष्ठ्य).

questions.prompt: Tap the four अन्तःस्थ वर्णाः.
questions.explanation: The अन्तःस्थ letters are य्, र्, ल्, व्.

questions.prompt: Tap the four ऊष्म वर्णाः.
questions.explanation: The ऊष्म letters are श्, ष्, स्, ह्.

questions.prompt: Which letter is the nasal of the क-वर्ग?
questions.explanation: ङ is the fifth letter of the क-वर्ग.

questions.prompt: Which member of this pair is महाप्राण?
questions.explanation: ख is aspirated (महाप्राण); क is unaspirated (अल्पप्राण).

questions.prompt: Which class is denoted by अच्?
questions.explanation: अच् denotes the vowel class; use the vowel inventory taught in the game.

questions.prompt: Tap the इक् वर्णाः, including their listed savarṇa long vowels.
questions.explanation: इक् expands to इ, ई, उ, ऊ, ऋ, ॠ, ऌ.

questions.prompt: Tap the यण् वर्णाः.
questions.explanation: यण् denotes य्, व्, र्, ल्.

questions.prompt: हल् denotes which class?
questions.explanation: हल् is the pratyāhāra for consonants.

questions.prompt: Which इत् marker closes the pratyāhāra अच्?
questions.explanation: The first Māheśvara sūtras end in the marker च् after ऐ औ.

questions.prompt: In the first Māheśvara sūtra अ इ उ ण्, which letter is the इत् marker?
questions.explanation: The final ण् marks the end of the sound sequence.

questions.prompt: Arrange these first four Māheśvara sūtra groups in order.
questions.explanation: This is the opening sequence of the Māheśvara sūtras.

questions.prompt: After इत्-lopa, what remains of तुमुँन्?
questions.explanation: The anunāsika उ and final न् are इत्; तस्य लोपः deletes them.

questions.prompt: After इत्-lopa, what remains of क्त्वा?
questions.explanation: The initial क् is इत् in this non-taddhita affix; it is deleted.

questions.prompt: After इत्-lopa, what remains of शप्?
questions.explanation: Initial श् and final प् are इत्; अ remains.

questions.prompt: After इत्-lopa, what remains of तिप्?
questions.explanation: The final प् is इत् and is deleted.

questions.prompt: Which sūtra marks a final consonant in an उपदेश as इत्?
questions.explanation: हलन्त्यम् is sūtra 1.3.3.

questions.prompt: Which sūtra assigns इत्-saṃjñā to an anunāsika vowel in an उपदेश?
questions.explanation: This is sūtra 1.3.2.

questions.prompt: Which sūtra deletes letters that have इत्-saṃjñā?
questions.explanation: इत् letters are deleted by तस्य लोपः.

questions.prompt: Why is the initial क् in क्त्वा marked as इत्?
questions.answer: It is an initial क् in a non-taddhita affix.
options: It is an initial क् in a non-taddhita affix.
It is a vowel before another vowel.
questions.explanation: लशक्वतद्धिते covers initial क-varga letters in non-taddhita affixes.

questions.prompt: In कर्तुम् (कृ + तुमुन्), which is the धातु / प्रकृति?
questions.explanation: कृ is the verbal base; तुमुन् is the affix.

questions.prompt: In पठित्वा (पठ् + क्त्वा), which प्रत्यय is used?
questions.explanation: क्त्वा forms an indeclinable meaning 'having read' here.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes प्रकृति and प्रत्यय?
questions.answer: प्रकृति is the base; प्रत्यय is added to it.
options: प्रकृति is the base; प्रत्यय is added to it.
प्रकृति is always a case ending.
questions.explanation: The base and suffix combine to form a derived word.

questions.prompt: Which suffix is a कृत् प्रत्यय in this set?
questions.explanation: क्त्वा is added to a dhātu; सुप् endings are nominal case endings.

questions.prompt: Join दधि + अत्र by vowel sandhi.
questions.explanation: इ is replaced by य् before the following vowel.

questions.prompt: Join मधु + इति by vowel sandhi.
questions.explanation: उ is replaced by व् before the following vowel.

questions.prompt: Join विद्या + आलयः.
questions.explanation: आ + आ combines as आ.

questions.prompt: Join गुरु + उपदेशः.
questions.explanation: उ + उ combines as ऊ.

questions.prompt: Join राम + ईश्वरः.
questions.explanation: अ + ई gives ए by guṇa sandhi.

questions.prompt: Join सदा + एव.
questions.explanation: आ + ए gives ऐ in this sandhi.

questions.prompt: Join इति + आदि.
questions.explanation: Final इ becomes य् before the following vowel.

questions.prompt: Which rule is taught by दधि + अत्र → दध्यत्र?
questions.explanation: A vowel of इक् becomes the corresponding यण् before a vowel.

questions.prompt: Split दध्यत्र into its two original words.
questions.explanation: दधि ends in इ and अत्र begins with अ.

questions.prompt: Split सदैव into its two original words.
questions.explanation: आ + ए gives ऐ.

questions.prompt: Which rule gives a long vowel when two savarṇa vowels meet?
questions.explanation: The rule is 6.1.101.

questions.prompt: Join सत् + जनः.
questions.explanation: The consonants change at the boundary; the established form is सज्जनः.

questions.prompt: Join सत् + आचारः.
questions.explanation: The final त् becomes द् before the following vowel.

questions.prompt: Join दिक् + अम्बरः.
questions.explanation: The final क् becomes ग् before the following vowel.

questions.prompt: What type of sandhi is illustrated by सत् + जनः → सज्जनः?
questions.explanation: A consonant boundary is involved.

questions.prompt: Join नमः + ते.
questions.explanation: Visarga becomes स् before त in this form.

questions.prompt: Join कविः + अयम्.
questions.explanation: Final इः before a vowel is represented by र् in this form.

questions.prompt: Join सः + अपि.
questions.explanation: अः before a vowel gives ओऽ in this form.

questions.prompt: What type of sandhi is shown in नमः + ते → नमस्ते?
questions.explanation: The starting form contains visarga.

questions.prompt: Complete the sūtra: पूर्वत्र ______।
questions.explanation: The phrase begins the asiddha discussion.

questions.prompt: Which sūtra number is पूर्वत्रासिद्धम्?
questions.explanation: पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् is sūtra 8.2.1.

questions.prompt: In the relevant rule context, असिद्ध means that a rule is treated as what?
questions.answer: As not yet effective for that operation.
options: As the final answer of a derivation.
As not yet effective for that operation.
questions.explanation: असिद्ध is a technical, context-governed notion; later rules and exceptions matter.

questions.prompt: In रामः पुस्तकं पठति, which word is the कर्ता?
questions.explanation: रामः performs the action.

questions.prompt: In रामः पुस्तकं पठति, which word is the कर्म?
questions.explanation: पुस्तकम् is what is read.

questions.prompt: In रामः लेखन्या पत्रं लिखति, which word is the करणम्?
questions.explanation: लेखन्या names the instrument used to write.

questions.prompt: In रामः बालकाय फलम् ददाति, which word is सम्प्रदानम्?
questions.explanation: बालकाय is the recipient.

questions.prompt: In वृक्षात् पत्रं पतति, which word is अपादानम्?
questions.explanation: वृक्षात् indicates the point of separation.

questions.prompt: In बालकः कक्षायां पठति, which word is अधिकरणम्?
questions.explanation: कक्षायाम् indicates the location.

questions.prompt: Tap the six commonly taught कारक names.
questions.explanation: These are the six core kāraka categories in this learning set.

questions.prompt: Which कारक role identifies the recipient of an action such as बालकाय in फलम् ददाति?
questions.explanation: सम्प्रदानम् is the recipient role.

questions.prompt: In रामः पठति, which role is expressed as the nominative subject and matched by the active verb?
questions.explanation: In the active sentence the agent is expressed in the nominative.

questions.prompt: In पुस्तकं रामेण पठ्यते, which role is expressed in the nominative and matched by the passive verb?
questions.explanation: The passive verb agrees with पुस्तकं; रामेण remains instrumental.

questions.prompt: Which form is the passive verb in पुस्तकं रामेण पठ्यते?
questions.explanation: पठ्यते is the कर्मणि प्रयोग form.

questions.prompt: What case and number is रामस्य?
questions.explanation: रामस्य expresses a genitive singular relation.

questions.prompt: What case is used in हे राम?
questions.explanation: हे राम is a singular vocative form.

questions.prompt: In मासम् अधीते, मासम् expresses what?
questions.explanation: Accusative can express time of continuous duration.

questions.prompt: In रामस्य पुस्तकम्, what relation does रामस्य express?
questions.explanation: The genitive expresses a relation such as possession.

questions.prompt: What is the singular vocative form in हे वायो?
questions.explanation: वायो is the संबोधन singular form used with हे.

questions.prompt: What is the nominative singular of राम?
questions.explanation: रामः is प्रथमा एकवचनम्.

questions.prompt: What is the accusative singular of राम?
questions.explanation: रामम् is द्वितीया एकवचनम्.

questions.prompt: What is the instrumental plural of राम?
questions.explanation: रामैः is तृतीया बहुवचनम्.

questions.prompt: What is the dative singular of राम?
questions.explanation: रामाय is चतुर्थी एकवचनम्.

questions.prompt: What is the locative plural of राम?
questions.explanation: रामेषु is सप्तमी बहुवचनम्.

questions.prompt: Complete: सः ______ (पठ्, लट्, प्रथमपुरुष, एकवचन).
questions.explanation: लट्, प्रथमपुरुष, एकवचन of पठ् is पठति.

questions.prompt: Complete: तौ ______ (पठ्, लट्, प्रथमपुरुष, द्विवचन).
questions.explanation: The third-person dual form is पठतः.

questions.prompt: Complete: ते ______ (पठ्, लट्, प्रथमपुरुष, बहुवचन).
questions.explanation: The third-person plural form is पठन्ति.

questions.prompt: Complete: त्वं ______ (पठ्, लट्, मध्यमपुरुष, एकवचन).
questions.explanation: The second-person singular form is पठसि.

questions.prompt: Complete: अहम् ______ (पठ्, लट्, उत्तमपुरुष, एकवचन).
questions.explanation: The first-person singular form is पठामि.

questions.prompt: In अद्य रामः पठति, which word is अव्ययम्?
questions.explanation: अद्य is indeclinable.

questions.prompt: Which is an उपसर्ग in प्रगच्छति?
questions.explanation: प्र is prefixed to the verbal root गम्.

questions.prompt: Add the उपसर्ग आ to गम् to form the common verb meaning 'comes'.
questions.explanation: आ + गम् forms आगच्छति in the present tense.

questions.prompt: Which word is an उपसर्ग in उपविशति?
questions.explanation: उप precedes the root विश्.

questions.prompt: Which statement describes an उपसर्ग?
questions.answer: A preverbal prefix that combines with a धातु.
options: A case ending added to a noun.
A preverbal prefix that combines with a धातु.
questions.explanation: Upasargas precede roots and contribute meaning.

questions.prompt: Which word is अव्ययम् in पुनः बालकः लिखति?
questions.explanation: पुनः is indeclinable.

questions.prompt: Which adjective form agrees with बालकः?
questions.explanation: Masculine nominative singular agreement: सुन्दरः बालकः.

questions.prompt: Which adjective form agrees with बालिका?
questions.explanation: Feminine nominative singular agreement: सुन्दरी बालिका.

questions.prompt: Which adjective form agrees with पुष्पम्?
questions.explanation: Neuter nominative singular agreement: सुन्दरं पुष्पम्.

questions.prompt: In नीलं पुष्पम्, which is the विशेषणम्?
questions.explanation: नीलम् qualifies पुष्पम्.

questions.prompt: Choose the agreeing adjective-noun pair.
questions.explanation: Both words are neuter nominative plural.

questions.prompt: Which form is made from गम् + तुमुन्?
questions.explanation: The तुमुन् form of गम् is गन्तुम्.

questions.prompt: Which form is made from कृ + तुमुन्?
questions.explanation: The तुमुन् form of कृ is कर्तुम्.

questions.prompt: Which form is made from दृश् + तुमुन्?
questions.explanation: The तुमुन् form of दृश् is द्रष्टुम्.

questions.prompt: Which form means 'having read'?
questions.explanation: पठित्वा is पठ् + क्त्वा.

questions.prompt: Which form means 'having done'?
questions.explanation: कृत्वा is कृ + क्त्वा.

questions.prompt: Which form means 'having gone'?
questions.explanation: गत्वा is गम् + क्त्वा.

questions.prompt: Which प्रत्यय usually expresses a completed prior action in forms such as पठित्वा?
questions.explanation: क्त्वा is used for a prior action by the same subject in common constructions.

questions.prompt: Which is the feminine form in the pair बालकः → ______?
questions.explanation: बालिका is the feminine form.

questions.prompt: Which प्रत्यय is named in अजाद्यतष्टाप्?
questions.explanation: This sūtra introduces टाप् for specified feminine formations.

questions.prompt: Which word is feminine?
questions.explanation: लता is feminine.

questions.prompt: Taddhita affixes are generally added to which kind of base?
questions.explanation: Taddhita affixes form nominal derivatives from nominal bases.

questions.prompt: Which suffix type is typically added to a धातु?
questions.explanation: Kṛt affixes are added to verbal roots; taddhita affixes to nominal bases.

questions.prompt: पाण्डवः is related by derivation to which base name?
questions.explanation: पाण्डव is a derivative associated with पाण्डु.

questions.prompt: What is the compound type of रामलक्ष्मणौ?
questions.explanation: The compound joins two coordinate members.

questions.prompt: What is the compound type of राजपुरुषः in the sense 'the king's man'?
questions.explanation: राज्ञः पुरुषः is a dependent relation.

questions.prompt: What is the compound type of यथाशक्ति?
questions.explanation: यथाशक्ति functions as an indeclinable compound.

questions.prompt: In पीतम् अम्बरम् यस्य सः, what compound type is पीताम्बरः?
questions.explanation: The compound describes an external referent: one whose garment is yellow.

questions.prompt: Match the sūtra number with its text.
questions.explanation: These are key early saṃjñā sūtras.

questions.prompt: Which sounds are called वृद्धि by 1.1.1 वृद्धिरादैच्?
questions.explanation: वृद्धि denotes आ, ऐ, औ.

questions.prompt: Which sounds are called गुण by 1.1.2 अदेङ् गुणः?
questions.explanation: गुण denotes अ, ए, ओ.

questions.prompt: Which sūtra defines सवर्ण?
questions.explanation: This is sūtra 1.1.9.
